data-portability.title: Data export
data-portability.description: Create the archive already available for Wealthbox migration records.
data-portability.backup-unavailable: Complete firm backup unavailable — needs review
data-portability.not-a-backup-title: This is not a complete firm backup.
data-portability.not-a-backup-description: This doorway only creates a copy of records brought in by the existing Wealthbox migration.
data-portability.includes-records: The source type, source ID, target record ID, and original imported payload for every record that passed the migration.
data-portability.includes-manifest: A manifest with the total record count and counts by source record type.
data-portability.includes-fidelity: The migration fidelity table with fetched, imported, skipped, and rejected counts.
data-portability.excludes: It does not include other workspace data, documents, email, or the payloads of migration rows that were skipped or rejected.
data-portability.decrypted-warning: The JSON file is decrypted. Store it only in a place your firm approves.
data-portability.workspace-required: Open a workspace before creating a migration archive.
data-portability.needs-review-error: The export needs review because it did not return a complete, inspectable archive receipt.
data-portability.export-failed: The migration archive could not be created.
